_doc: The global heartbeat — wall-clock twin of the git-backed oracle (scripts/oracle.py). SSOT for subsystem freshness budgets, in BEATS (1 beat = 1 day). global_beat = (today - genesis).days. Proof-of-life for each subsystem = git commit timestamp of its artifacts (tamper-evident OT layer), NOT self-report. Managed by scripts/pulse.py; do not hand-edit last_beat (the guard recomputes it from git). max_beats and artifacts ARE the human-owned config. See scripts/pulse.py header for the full contract.

_seams.precall-postcall: Disabled pollers (off since 2026-07). Register here with expected:inactive when ready to track them so their silence is visible on the board.
_seams.status.arcs.care: External witness (NOT built in Phase 0). Reads THIS committed file at build-time or via a tiny Vercel serverless read and renders 'last beat: N ago · FRESH/STALE'. No standing FastAPI — git is the proof-of-life. Consume via `python3 scripts/pulse.py status --json` or read pulse.json directly.
_seams.time-signature-alignment: Phase 4 seam — per-tenant local_beat + alignment factor phase-locked to global_beat (spec §Time-signature alignment). Not in Phase 0.

canon-propagation._role: nightly canon-propagation cron (scripts/canon_propagation_nightly.sh via launchd). Registered so a disabled/unloaded cron SURFACES rather than rotting silently — the precall/postcall lesson. Set expected:inactive to mark it DORMANT instead of FLATLINE while intentionally off.

commits._role: repo heartbeat — the primary canary. If no work lands in git for >max_beats days the operational layer has gone quiet (the drift-sentry-went-silent-5d failure). Daily guard alarms on day 2.

lattice-drift._role: knowledge-lattice drift sentry (scripts/lattice_drift_check.py). max_beats absorbs the old STALE_DAYS=14 for the lattice epoch.

oracle._role: the sequence authority — pulse's twin. Its committed counter should advance as ADRs/seeds/handoffs are minted.

seedbank-drift._role: seed-bank drift sentry (scripts/seedbank_drift_check.py). max_beats absorbs the old STALE_DAYS=21 for the ledger.
